implemented: Editing mode emits real Word paragraphs, heading styles with outline levels, preserved run emphasis and merged-cell tables
Text rows split at horizontal gutters, with column-major reading order between spanning headings/footnote text
Only ruled tables are inferred in this conversion; aligned article columns are not silently converted to borderless tables
Unequal table-column widths and merged header spans are written to Word grid/cell widths
Visible embedded-image regions are cropped from actual rendered pages after graphics-state clipping, preserving orientation/compositing; no borrowed PDFBox bitmap recycling
Each source page supplies its own crop/rotation/UserUnit paper geometry via sections
Appearance mode uses full-page floating pictures and explicitly declares that text and cells are not independently editable
Single and batch presets, durable conversion report, report inside DOCX and actual-source/result comparison

cases: row-major painted PDF becomes left-column-then-right-column Word stream
heading/footnote text styles and all 00123/00456 identifiers
unequal-width two-column table and merged header
clipped red/green source image exports only the visible red crop
two different paper sizes and two actual Office-rendered pages in both modes
persistent tool-report and mode-specific completion notice

limits: Editing mode intentionally reflows columns; it does not reconstruct arbitrary floating layout, mathematical objects or original font metrics
Footnotes remain small styled text in reading order; semantic footnote references are not guessed
Borderless tables use the separate explicit table workspace
Visible image crops carry actual composited pixels from that region, including any overlapping content
Appearance uses 2200px page images; actual Office paper rounding differs by up to about 1.1pt on this mixed-size sample
Concentrated authored fixture and emulator UI; no general high-fidelity or physical-phone quality claim
No new version, tag or release
